identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Pomalidomide and Low Dose Dexamethasone With or Without Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) in Refractory or Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma (rrMM) (MK-3475-183/KEYNOTE-183)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Study of Pomalidomide and Low Dose Dexamethasone With or Without Pembrolizumab (MK3475) in Refractory or Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma (rrMM) (KEYNOTE 183)

armGroups.label: Pembrolizumab+Pomalidomide+Dexamethasone
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg intravenously (IV) on Day 1 every 3 weeks (Q3W) PLUS pomalidomide 4 mg orally (PO) on Days 1 to 21 of each 28-day cycle PLUS dexamethasone 40 mg PO on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Pomalidomide+Dexamethasone
armGroups.description: Participants receive pomalidomide 4 mg PO on Days 1 to 21 of each 28-day cycle PLUS dexamethasone 40 mg PO on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day cycle.
